title: Project Support Administrator
description:
Belmont Recruitment are currently looking for a Project Support Administrator to join Bradford Council's Children and Family Service on an initial 3-6 month temporary contract. This is a full-time role working 37 hours per week, Monday to Friday.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide project support to the delivery of projects and best value reviews within the Children and Families service.
- Work closely with Contract and Quality Officers to support the smooth delivery of review activity.
- Collect, collate and maintain accurate project and service information.
- Monitor project activity, progress and agreed actions.
- Support the recording and reporting of the impact and outcomes of best value reviews.
- Prepare reports, briefings and management information as required.
- Maintain project documentation, records, action logs and supporting evidence.
- Liaise with internal teams and stakeholders to gather information and ensure deadlines are met.
- Identify gaps, issues or concerns within project information and escalate where appropriate.
- Support meetings, including preparing information, recording actions and following up outstanding tasks.

Requirements:
- Experience providing project or business support.
- Strong administrative and organisational skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Experience maintaining accurate records and project documentation.

Please apply with an up to date CV ASAP if this role would be of interest to you.

title: Service Administrator
company: Bradford District Care NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: Bradford District Care NHS Foundation Trust
description: Bradford District Care NHS Foundation Trust's Hub Teams are multi-disciplined teams of administrators dealing with enquiries from patients, service users, carers and clinicians. The service is delivered in an Inpatient Hospital Environment providing admin support to Clinical Teams Monday - Friday, operating core office hours. The Administrator role will provide efficient, effective and high quality clerical support to a range of identified professionals within clinical inpatient services. The role requires someone who is able to travel between Bradford Royal infirmary and Lynfield Mount Hospital Closing- 20th September 2026 Shortlisting- 21st September 2026 Interview- 29th September 2026 (provisionally) The Administrator role will provide an efficient, effective, and high-quality administrative support to health and social care professionals and service users/patients within a community based or district wide team. Service Administrator roles support Medics and/or Clinical Teams, these roles will be supporting the Inpatient Flow Management team and ALPS service for 12 months. Please read the attached Job description and person specification for more details about this role. Right to Work in the UK Applicants should be aware that for any individual who requires a visa to work in the UK, the Trust provides sponsorship for registered healthcare practitioner roles only. This is an essential requirement of the role, and the Trust is unable to offer you a role if you are unable to meet Trust requirements for sponsorship and Home Office requirements for a visa. Prior to your appointment you will be asked to provide confirmation of your right to work and reside in the UK. During your continued employment with the Trust, you have a personal responsibility to notify your manager as soon as possible should there be any changes to your right to work status. Regrettably, if the role is not eligible for sponsorship under the Trusts eligibility criteria, the Trust are unable to extend your employment beyond the expiration of your current visa. The Trust is not responsible or liable for ensuring that your employment continues after this period. As a condition of continuous employment, it essential you maintain the legal right to work in the United Kingdom throughout the duration of your employment with Bradford District Care NHS Foundation Trust (BDCFT). Any change in your right-to-work status, including but not limited to visa expiration, revocation, or denial of renewal, may impact your eligibility for employment with the Trust. It is your responsibility to promptly inform your Line Manager of any changes in your right-to-work status immediately and to provide necessary documentation for verification purposes. Failure to obtain or renew your visa in a timely manner is a breach of employment conditions and will result in termination of your employment. We appreciate your attention to this matter and your commitment to fulfilling this requirement promptly.
